title: CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted (1982-84 = 100)
source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. Public domain.
note: Used to restate historical auction prices in today's dollars. Refresh with `node tools/pull-cpi.mjs`, which appends completed years from the BLS public API. Years missing here are NOT guessed by the code — realPrice.js reports them as a gap, or extends the series only when the caller passes an explicit assumedAnnualInflationPct, and then labels the result 'assumed'.
